string.text: {=gwp_clan_intro}We are the Grey Wardens, a constabulary house descended from the institutions of the old, undivided Empire. The Empire is broken, yet lawful succession endures. Dynasties may rise and fall; streets, villages, and roads must still be watched. Call us a clan or call us an order—it is all one to us. So long as the common folk cry out for justice, the Grey Wardens shall answer.
